newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks plunge on GDR selling abroad.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks plunge on GDR selling abroad.

text.p: Pakistani stocks plunged 2.71 percent on Thursday in bearish sentiment prompted by declines in the rates of global depositary receipts (GDRs) of two leading blue chips, dealers said.

"The constant decline in the GDR rates of...of Hub Power and PTCL pulled the market down," dealer Hussain Ali Rajabali said. He said the fall in prices of the market leaders resulted in an across-the-board panic selling.
The Karachi Stock Exchange (KSE) 100-share index fell 47.26 points to end at 1,694.73. Losers led gainers 262 to 72. Turnover rose to 59 million shares from Wednesday's 57 million.

Askari Bank fell 1.50 rupees to 32.25, Adamjee Insurance 2.0 to 111, Dewan Salman Fibre 0.20 to 44.80, Hub Power Co 1.05 to 40.55, Pakistan State Oil 9.0 to 311 and Shell Pakistan 5.0 to 205. PTCL dropped 0.90 to 29.90.
ICI Pakistan fell 0.60 to 27.60, FFC Jordan 0.35 to 18, Engro Chemical 9.0 to 185 and Fauji Fertilizer 2.75 to 80.50.
